{{Quote|Hesa Cap'n Rohd Gostervek, mooie bombad Imperial. Hesa patrollin' de wilderness, lookin' for dis base. Hesa always protected, so yousa be careful, hey?|Booto Lubble|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Rohd Gostervek''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] that lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Booto Lubble]], a [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], ordered [[Gender/Legends|him]] [[Death/Legends|killed]].
